title: 美驻印大使谈双边商业纽带
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: And Mr. Gore, we can't possibly leave the stage without talking about AI.
segments.zh: 戈尔先生，我们总不能离场前不谈人工智能。

segments.en: I'd love to hear your perspective of what you're seeing about the AI developments in the region.
segments.zh: 很想听听您对该地区人工智能发展的看法。

segments.en: We heard from Prime Minister Modi two days ago at this conference here in Delhi that he really wants India to be an AI power in the world.
segments.zh: 两天前，莫迪总理在德里这次会议上表示，他希望印度成为世界人工智能强国。

segments.en: What evidence of that are you seeing? So I'll give the Indian government and Prime Minister Modi credit to this.
segments.zh: 您看到了哪些证据？这方面我要称赞印度政府和莫迪总理。

segments.en: They've got a great team that is pushing this here. They hosted the Global AI Summit and where they brought the whole world the United States participated in that also earlier this year.
segments.zh: 他们有一个很棒的团队在推动这件事。他们主办了全球人工智能峰会，今年早些时候美国也参与了。

segments.en: One of the things that resulted from it and it's another sign of our relationship with India.
segments.zh: 峰会成果之一，也是我们与印度关系的又一体现。

segments.en: India was among the first ten countries invited into Paksilika.
segments.zh: 印度是首批受邀加入Paksilika的十个国家之一。

segments.en: And the reason for that is because they are our trusted partner. You're seeing things happen that the news doesn't often reflect that gets lost in the noise.
segments.zh: 原因在于他们是我们的可信伙伴。有些事新闻不常反映，容易被噪音淹没。

segments.en: We invite trusted partners. India is one of those trusted partners.
segments.zh: 我们邀请可信伙伴。印度就是其中之一。

segments.en: So for them to be an essential part of our supply chain that the trust is there.
segments.zh: 因此，他们成为我们供应链的重要部分，信任是存在的。

segments.en: Another example of that just last week we had for the first time ever F-35s in India.
segments.zh: 另一个例子就在上周，F-35首次抵达印度。

segments.en: Our F-35s don't go all over the world. They don't go to places we don't trust.
segments.zh: 我们的F-35不会飞遍全球，也不会去我们不信任的地方。

segments.en: And they came here for a joint exercise with the Indians.
segments.zh: 它们来这里与印度进行联合演习。

segments.en: So that's another example of trust. Go back to your question on AI.
segments.zh: 这是信任的又一例证。回到你关于AI的问题。

segments.en: AI will also lead into civil, um, Sivnuq.
And so the Sivnuq development is vitally important because India needs more energy and it's going to be growing that energy.
segments.zh: 因此Sivnuq的发展至关重要，因为印度需要更多能源，并且将持续增长能源需求。

segments.en: And so we've brought American technology, American genuity. The Indians have passed legislation to enable those private companies who come here and they're looking at SMRs.
segments.zh: 所以我们带来了美国技术和美国智慧。印度已通过立法，允许那些来此的私营公司参与，他们正在关注小型模块化反应堆。

segments.en: In a way a lot of these things are interconnected, right?
segments.zh: 在某种程度上，许多事情是相互关联的，对吧？
